context: Governance closure after live NL/EN route-authority recovery.
lessons: A ready exact production deploy is deployment evidence, not blanket functional evidence for every sub-flow.
Live recovery is not governance-complete until skills, agent/chat contracts, Brain learning, ledger/docs and System Map contain the same truth-boundary and are read back.
Historical LIVE/GREEN may never be reused as current health without fresh runtime/provider readback.
prevention: Persist terminal production identity after each material live recovery.
Project the same rule into Green Assurance, continuity and AGENTS/chat contract.
Keep functional sub-gates independent from deploy-state truth.
truth_boundary: This record proves governance writeback and historical exact deployment identity; it does not assert future runtime health without fresh readback.
